lead.headline: Ukrainian sea drones sink Russian corvette Merkury at Libyan port
lead.dek: Zelensky confirmed the Benghazi strike Monday; Libya's eastern government asked the UN to investigate where the drones came from
body: Ukrainian naval drones sank the Russian navy corvette Merkury at its berth in the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya on Sunday, President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed Monday morning, calling it "an exemplary Ukrainian operation." Satellite images showed the ship capsized beside the pier with only its bow above water and smoke over the harbor.

Seven Ukrainian-made drones were launched from a mother ship, Ukraine's SBU security service said, and Zelensky said a Ka-27 helicopter was destroyed with the corvette and the Russian cargo ship MV Angara was also hit. Libyan military officials told The Associated Press that two drones struck the Merkury and at least four were intercepted; a second drone hit a commercial ship off the port that evening.

The eastern Libyan government said the Merkury, commissioned in 2023, had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way home under a cooperation agreement, and opened a joint investigation with Moscow. Prime Minister Osama Hamad asked the UN Security Council to examine whether the drones came from western Libya, where officials have said Ukrainian specialists operate. The Kremlin referred questions to the military.

briefs.headline: Democrats clinch at least 258 House seats, most since 1992
briefs.summary: Chuck Hubbard's win over Rep. Virginia Foxx in North Carolina Sunday gave Democrats 258 of 435 seats; four races are uncalled. Speaker vote is Jan. 3.

briefs.headline: Army asks court to let it blow up Iowa explosives by Tuesday
briefs.summary: Lawyers asked the 8th Circuit late Saturday to let the Army invoke emergency provisions despite Thursday's stay, saying the lead azide destabilizes in the cold.

briefs.headline: Delta weight-system failure delays more than 1,000 flights
briefs.summary: Delta said about 70% of Sunday's delays traced to the automation fault, the rest to weather; FlightAware counted about 3% of flights canceled.

briefs.headline: Gunfire at California concert wounds 9, one critically
briefs.summary: Tulare County deputies said suspects fired on a crowd of about 150 in Strathmore Saturday night; a 26-year-old man is critical after surgery. No arrests yet.

briefs.headline: Russian strikes kill 15 in Kyiv region; Dymer toll hits 11
briefs.summary: Regional chief Tymur Tkachenko said 11 people, two of them children, were still unaccounted for in the Dymer block hit Sunday; a Vyshneve store strike killed three.

briefs.headline: Indonesia confirms 24 dead in candy factory fire; 30 missing
briefs.summary: Rescuers removed 24 body bags from the Fonusa Agung Mulia plant in Banten; about 30 workers are unaccounted for. A presidential adviser cited a short circuit, preliminarily.

briefs.headline: Tanker reports incident with military forces east of Hormuz
briefs.summary: UKMTO said a tanker near Chabahar was involved in an incident Sunday; Iranian media, citing the navy, said two supertankers caught fire after hitting mines.

briefs.headline: COP31 collapses as EU rejects text that omits fossil fuels
briefs.summary: President Murat Kurum closed the Antalya talks Sunday, two days into overtime, with no new text; Ireland's Darragh O'Brien, for the EU, called the omission 'unconscionable.'

briefs.headline: Buck firearms season opens under new two-buck limit
briefs.summary: The two-week season runs through Dec. 6. DNR's deer project leader said last year's EHD outbreak thinned Wood County herds and a poor acorn crop will push deer into open fields.

briefs.headline: SBA to redistribute $20M after Kanawha drops school plan
briefs.summary: Kanawha's board abandoned Country Roads Elementary Thursday; the School Building Authority meets Dec. 17 in Charleston with as much as $81 million in needs grants to award.

briefs.headline: Bankruptcy judge approves $422M Pleasants plant sale
briefs.summary: A Delaware judge approved selling the 1,278-megawatt coal plant, free of liens, to an affiliate of Texas-based Rockland Capital; owner Omnis Pleasants filed Chapter 11 in July. The plant has 140 employees.

briefs.headline: Three die, including infant, in Wayne County house fire
briefs.summary: The house on Jennie's Creek Road near Kermit was fully involved when crews arrived Sunday morning; CPR on an adult and the infant failed. The state Fire Marshal is investigating.

regional.item: Huntington's council votes tonight on a $27,540 consulting contract for elevator upgrades at the municipal parking garage.
Parkersburg South's cheerleader-run fall festival drew about 250 vendors Saturday, with nearly 500 shoppers through one door by 1 p.m.
The Park Service plans $36M of Outdoors Act work at Thurmond; a demolition contractor is due Nov. 30 while the town's suit awaits a ruling.

away.item: Police run Thanksgiving saturation patrols and DUI checkpoints Nov. 25-29, officials said Thursday at Bennington Rescue Squad headquarters.

hotspots.item: Webster County's Lady Highlanders are in preseason practice under the motto "Earn Everything" for the 2026-27 basketball season, The Webster Echo reported Nov. 16.
Surf City's council holds a Dec. 1 hearing, 6 p.m., on a zoning change defining farmers markets and permitting them in four commercial districts, per a Nov. 17 notice.

briefs.headline: Cariboo district presses Ottawa, Victoria on rural internet
briefs.summary: Chair Margo Wagner said Lone Butte, on Highway 24, still has no fibre and Ottawa's goal of 98% of Canadians on high-speed internet by 2026 is unlikely to be met. Staff have written to Rogers.

briefs.headline: Tumbler Ridge asks residents to pick design for new school
briefs.summary: School District 59 offers a prefabricated or site-built secondary school in a two-week survey; construction could start in summer 2027. Six people were killed at the old school Feb. 10.

briefs.headline: B.C. Greens take oath as Lowan faults new government on LNG
briefs.summary: Leader Emily Lowan and Jeremy Valeriote are sworn in at 2 p.m. in Victoria; New Democrats follow Thursday. Lowan said tripling LNG exports is the wrong direction after COP31 ended without a deal.

briefs.headline: RCMP identify driver in Sechelt hit-and-run that killed teen
briefs.summary: Sunshine Coast RCMP said Saturday the driver is co-operating and the pickup and flat-deck trailer are in police custody. The 16-year-old was struck in Davis Bay just after 6:20 p.m. Nov. 18.

briefs.headline: U.S. trade chief Greer says Canada deal 'fairly close'
briefs.summary: Jamieson Greer told Fox News on Sunday talks are constructive. The 25% U.S. tariff on Canadian autos is the largest open issue, and Washington objects to Canada admitting 49,000 Chinese EVs a year.

briefs.headline: Ottawa quietly pauses blended refugee sponsorship program
briefs.summary: IRCC said the BVOR program is closed but matched refugees will still arrive; it admitted 82 people in 2025 against a target of 100, down from up to 1,000 a decade ago. Sponsor groups said there was no announcement.

briefs.headline: SpaceX sets 32-hour pad turnaround with NRO launch
briefs.summary: A Falcon 9 carried classified NROL-136 payloads from Vandenberg at 7:23 a.m. ET Sunday, 32 hours 3 minutes after USSF-317 left the same pad; SpaceX's Kiko Dontchev said the old record was 45 hours.

briefs.headline: Astronomers watch a giant star swallow its companion
briefs.summary: A Columbia-led team reported in Nature that a star seven times the Sun's mass in Andromeda brightened for seven years, then flared 100-fold in 25 days in October 2025 as its partner hit its core.

briefs.headline: Heart association projects 20M US stroke survivors by 2050
briefs.summary: A statement in the journal Stroke projects adults living after a stroke will nearly double to 20 million by 2050, with annual costs rising from about $65B to $423B and the fastest growth at ages 20 to 44.

briefs.headline: Sub finds deepest explosive eruptions near Challenger Deep
briefs.summary: Seven dives by the ROV Jason/Medea found pyroclastic rock on the Mariana Trench wall down to 6,500 meters, a UT Dallas-led team reported in Frontiers in Earth Science; the eruption sites are not yet located.

briefs.headline: Researchers evade China's firewall for $1 in GPT-5.1 tokens
briefs.summary: CircumVolve, built at UMass Amherst, CU Boulder and Great Firewall Report, has GPT-5.1 write packet-level evasion code; the median cost to a first working bypass was under $1, an ACM CCS paper said.

briefs.headline: OpenRouter drops 3 providers after prompt-leak study
briefs.summary: OpenRouter removed three providers and revoked zero-data-retention status for 125 endpoints after Dragos's 2 million canary requests found three compromised hosts and stolen AWS keys used within hours.

briefs.headline: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero goal as emissions rise 40%
briefs.summary: Meta's Nov. 19 sustainability report put 2025 emissions at 21.7 million metric tons of CO2 equivalent, up from 15.6 million, the biggest rise among the four big U.S. tech firms; the company said it is re-evaluating 2030.

weather_ear: Monday's forecast lands at 7:15, from Jim Claudtore.
kicker: Putnam-Kanawha and Nicholas-Webster carry no regional line today; buck firearms season runs through Dec. 6.

art.caption: The Benghazi naval pier from overhead Sunday: the Merkury capsized off the quay's end, smoke over the basin, a scorch on the concrete.
